summary: Nayax Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 furnishing a press release announcing completion of its acquisition of IPS Group, Inc., a smart-parking payments provider, from Windjammer Capital Investors. The all-cash transaction carries a $350 million enterprise value on a cash-free, debt-free basis, roughly 17x 2026E Adjusted EBITDA, or about 12x including over $8 million of run-rate synergies. Nayax funded it with cash on hand plus about $150 million of new debt from Poalim Tech and First International Bank of Israel. IPS, serving more than 250,000 parking spaces, is expected to contribute $20-22 million revenue and over $5 million Adjusted EBITDA in FY2026; closing integration and synergy delivery are the key watch items. Jefferies advised Nayax, with Reed Smith as legal counsel.
